search_terms: WEE1 inhibitor p53 mutant sensitization
inclusion_rationale: Isogenic HNSCC lines (TP53 wild-type vs mutant vs p53-null) plus orthotopic xenografts; MK-1775/adavosertib at nanomolar doses abrogated the cisplatin-induced G2 block and chemosensitised only the p53-defective lines, with in vivo confirmation in TP53-mutant tumours.

search_terms: WEE1 inhibitor p53 mutant sensitization
inclusion_rationale: Endometrial and ovarian lines stratified by p53 status; AZD1775 single-agent activity and its synergy with olaparib or gemcitabine were confined to mutant-p53 models, consistent with G2/M checkpoint dependence after G1/S loss.

search_terms: CHK1 inhibitor p53 mutant synthetic lethal
inclusion_rationale: HNSCC panel with wild-type versus mutant/null TP53; wild-type cells senesce after cisplatin while p53-deficient cells resist, and Chk1/2 inhibition with AZD7762 restored cisplatin killing via mitotic death selectively in the p53-deficient background.

search_terms: CHK1 inhibitor p53 mutant synthetic lethal
inclusion_rationale: p53-null BRCA-proficient AsPC-1 and H1299 versus H1299 reconstituted with hotspot mutant p53; Chk1 inhibitor MK-8776 induced BRCAness and synergised with olaparib under sub-IC concentrations in the p53-depleted context.

search_terms: CHK1 inhibitor p53 mutant synthetic lethal
inclusion_rationale: High-throughput G2-checkpoint-abrogation screen; the guanidine analogue CBP-93872 blocked Chk1 phosphorylation and suppressed growth of p53-mutated CDKN2A-wild-type lines but not of wild-type-p53 lines, a direct genotype-stratified comparison.

search_terms: VE-821 ATR inhibitor p53 defective
inclusion_rationale: Isogenic p53 wild-type versus null/mutant pairs assayed by colony formation; VE-821 conferred consistently greater gemcitabine and radiation sensitisation in the p53-defective partner, with no sensitisation of non-malignant MCF10 cells.

search_terms: synthetic lethal screen p53 deficient cells kinase
inclusion_rationale: Cell-based screen yielding nanomolar ATR inhibitors; pharmacological ATR inhibition was shown to be particularly toxic to p53-deficient cells relative to p53-proficient controls, exacerbated by replicative stress from cyclin E overexpression.

search_terms: synthetic lethal screen p53 deficient cells kinase
inclusion_rationale: Genome-wide siRNA screen in p53-proficient versus p53-defective HCT116; ATR knockdown emerged as a synthetic-lethal hit that sensitised the p53-defective cells to etoposide in growth, clonogenic and Top2-covalent-complex assays.

search_terms: MAPKAPK2 p53 synthetic lethal
inclusion_rationale: Reversible gene-targeting generating isogenic MK2-proficient and MK2-deficient tumours within the same animal in an autochthonous p53-deficient NSCLC model; MK2 loss removed cisplatin resistance specifically in p53-null tumours.

search_terms: MAPKAPK2 p53 synthetic lethal
inclusion_rationale: p53-deficient PC-3 prostate model versus p53-proficient comparators in vitro and in vivo; the cytarabine analogue F-Se-Ara-C killed via inhibition of MK2 activation, exploiting the p53-MK2 synthetic-lethal interaction that ordinary nucleoside drugs cannot.

search_terms: mutant p53 mevalonate pathway statin gain of function
inclusion_rationale: Murine lung adenocarcinomas carrying p53-null, conformational and contact mutant alleles compared head-to-head plus p53 restoration; statin sensitivity was allele-specific to the contact mutant, whereas p53 restoration was equally effective across genotypes.

search_terms: mutant p53 mevalonate pathway statin gain of function
inclusion_rationale: Autochthonous T-lymphoma models expressing p53 R248Q or R172H compared with p53-null littermates; rosuvastatin monotherapy produced a transient allele-selective anti-tumour effect in R248Q tumours and none in p53-null mice.

search_terms: mutant p53 HSP90 inhibitor ganetespib degradation tumor
inclusion_rationale: Hotspot knockin mice (R248Q, R172H) versus their p53-null littermates; long-term HSP90 inhibition extended survival by 48-59% only in the mutant-p53 animals, with drug activity tracking induction of mutant p53 degradation.

search_terms: mutant p53 HSP90 inhibitor ganetespib degradation tumor
inclusion_rationale: Autochthonous T-lymphomas in p53 R248Q/- versus p53-/- mice; ganetespib synergised with sub-effective cyclophosphamide to extend PFS and OS in the mutant-p53 genotype while worsening OS in the p53-null genotype.

search_terms: APR-246 PRIMA-1 mutant p53 reactivation apoptosis selective
inclusion_rationale: TP53-mutant PANC-1 and BxPC-3 compared with TP53 wild-type CAPAN-2; PRIMA-1/APR-246 selectively induced apoptosis and cell-cycle arrest in the mutant lines and its effect was abolished by p53 siRNA, establishing mutant-p53 dependence.

search_terms: arsenic trioxide structural mutant p53 reactivator rescue
inclusion_rationale: Cysteine-reactive screen with crystal structures of arsenic-bound mutants; ATO restored thermostability and transcriptional activity to structural p53 mutants and suppressed tumours in cell and xenograft models in a mutation-dependent manner across 25 hotspot alleles.

search_terms: zinc metallochaperone ZMC1 p53 R175H reactivation
inclusion_rationale: ZMC1 acts as a zinc metallochaperone restoring wild-type structure and function specifically to zinc-binding-deficient p53 mutants such as R175H, inducing apoptosis in mutant-bearing lines and not through a wild-type-p53 mechanism.

search_terms: POLQ polymerase theta inhibitor p53 deficient tumor
inclusion_rationale: Genome-wide CRISPR screen plus TP53-mutant versus TP53-proficient cell lines, organoids and PDX; TP53-mutant cells maintained elevated POLQ and increased novobiocin sensitivity, and the peposertib/novobiocin combination was synthetic-lethal in TP53-deficient models only.

search_terms: synthetic lethal screen p53 deficient cells kinase
inclusion_rationale: Kinome-wide synthetic-lethal RNAi screen in ovarian cancer; SRMS suppression sensitised p53-deficient but not p53-proficient cells to platinum in vitro and in vivo, and PLX4720 was identified as a repurposed SRMS inhibitor reproducing the effect.

search_terms: CHK1 inhibitor p53 mutant synthetic lethal
inclusion_rationale: Isogenic cells with and without mutp53-R273H expression; mutant p53 attenuates the ATR replication-stress checkpoint via TopBP1, and DNA2 depletion or DNA2 inhibitors rendered mutp53-R273H-expressing cells hypersensitive to cisplatin relative to controls.

search_terms: PPM1D WIP1 inhibitor GSK2830371 p53 wild-type sensitivity
inclusion_rationale: INVERSE-DIRECTION: neuroblastoma panel split by TP53 status; TP53 wild-type lines were highly sensitive to the selective WIP1/PPM1D antagonist GSK2830371 whereas TP53-mutant lines were resistant, so p53 loss confers resistance rather than sensitivity.

search_terms: PPM1D WIP1 inhibitor GSK2830371 p53 wild-type sensitivity
inclusion_rationale: INVERSE-DIRECTION: TP53 wild-type cell lines and their matched mutant/null partners; Nutlin-3/RG7388 activity and its potentiation by WIP1 inhibition occurred strictly in the TP53 wild-type members of each pair, confirming MDM2 antagonists are wild-type-p53-selective.

search_terms: mutant p53 proteasome machinery Nrf2 carfilzomib triple negative breast
inclusion_rationale: INVERSE-DIRECTION: multi-omics comparison of p53 missense mutant versus non-mutant cancer cells; mutant p53 cooperates with NFE2L2 to transcriptionally upregulate proteasome genes and thereby confers resistance to carfilzomib, which is reversed by mutant-p53 inactivation with APR-246.
